items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag rejection
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Familienkasse Muster-Mitte, Postfach 44 01, 34002 Neu-Musterdorf, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 21 Nov 2025. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a posted authority letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 25 Nov 2025 (no weekend shift applies to this deemed-delivery rule itself). Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the next day. One month later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) lands on Thu 25 Dec 2025, which is a public holiday (Erster Weihnachtstag) nationwide, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 29 Dec 2025.

warnings: The letter states the request for Kinderzuschlag was rejected because household income exceeds the maximum income limit under § 6a Abs. 1 Nr. 3 BKGG; check the enclosed income calculation (Anlage) for accuracy before deciding whether to object.
The letter references an enclosed calculation annex ('beigefügten Anlage') that was not provided with this document, so the income figures behind the rejection cannot be independently verified.
